description: This file defines the Config class responsible for loading and managing OFBiz server startup parameters from configuration files and system properties.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Final class representing the OFBiz server configuration settings, loaded during startup from properties files and environment variables.

methods.name: getLogDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of loader components to be initialized during startup.

methods.name: isShutdownAfterLoad
methods.description: Indicates whether the server should shut down automatically after loading.

methods.name: isUseShutdownHook
methods.description: Indicates whether the shutdown hook should be utilized.

methods.name: getAdminAddress
methods.description: Returns the InetAddress object for the admin host.

methods.name: getAdminKey
methods.description: Returns the admin key used for authentication.

methods.name: getAdminPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for admin access.

methods.name: getPortOffset
methods.description: Returns the port offset value applied to port numbers.

methods.name: getOfbizHome
methods.description: Returns the file path representing the OFBiz home directory.
